description: PAYG tax to withhold from a bonus, commission or other one-off payment made with a regular Australian pay, using ATO Schedule 5 Method A, for 2025-26 or 2026-27. Use it for 'how much tax comes out of my bonus'. Returns the tax on the bonus only, never more than 47% of it; work out the regular pay's withholding separately with payg_withholding. Amounts in AUD. Read-only and deterministic.

earnings.description: Regular gross earnings for the pay period the bonus is paid with (AUD), excluding the bonus.

foreignResident.description: Foreign resident for tax purposes. Default false.

periodsCovered.description: Pay periods the bonus relates to, if less than a year.

studyLoan.description: Has a HELP, VSL, SSL or other study and training support loan. Default false.

taxFreeThreshold.description: Tax-free threshold claimed with this employer. Default true (main job). Use false for a second job.

taxYear.description: Australian financial year (1 July to 30 June) whose withholding tables to use. Default 2026-27.

tfnProvided.description: Employee gave their tax file number. Default true. False applies the no-TFN rate.

name: bonus_withholding
title: Tax withheld from a bonus
